sources.text:
Prokoško Lake (Cyrillic: Прокошко Језеро) is a lake in Bosnia and Herzegovina. It is located in the municipality of Fojnica and is 1,670 metres (5,480 ft) above sea level.
The lake is visited by around 20,000 tourists each year.
